references.text: The tithe of the harvest was to be dedicated to the Lord, reflecting the principle of consecrating the first fruits and crops to God.
The first yield of the harvest was to be given to the Lord, following the same principle of dedicating the fruits to God.
The best of the first produce from the land was to be brought to the house of the Lord, paralleling the act of setting apart the fruits as holy to the Lord.
The first yield of oil, wine, and grain was to be given to the Lord, sharing the same idea of consecrating the first fruits.
Honor the Lord with your wealth and with the first produce of all your harvest - the principle of giving the first and best to God.
Every tithe of the land belongs to the Lord and is holy to him, reflecting the same concept that the fruits are קֹדֶשׁ (holy) for the Lord.
The term הִלּוּלִים (praise festival) is mentioned here in connection with the harvest feast; the same word is used in Leviticus 19:24.
